decisions: End is admitted only for the captured nonloop window at its exact endpoint and generation. The playback controller pauses and tears down the device before publishing End.
The terminal path keeps one useful decode/GPU request, or schedules the final included frame once. Successful submission must match both the generation and the actual submitted serial.
Manual pause, navigation, edits and failures retain cancellation semantics. An ended run cannot resume from an older Playing/Preparing update, and terminal Space creates no resume token.
Original, committed Edit and proposed picture paths share the ticket gate; sound-only and Trim are excluded. Proxy completion still receives the stopped exact-refinement request.
The runtime has no new queue, worker or authored-state write. The End observation copy and per-picture classification are restricted to ui-harness.
Coverage through End is explicitly distinct from physical or acoustic timeliness. The previous missed-final-picture report remains an unchanged failure.
Gain waveform replay failure repeats byte-identically on the prior binary while transport is absent. It is retained as an open DP-20 observation, not treated as a successful regression test.
remaining_risks: Broader format, effects and master pipeline remain outside these fixtures
Gain compact waveform visibility replay remains unresolved
